en_title: GTA 6 Doesn't Let You Replay Missions, and Rockstar Says There's a Good Reason for That
cn_title: 《GTA 6》不允许玩家重玩任务，Rockstar称这是有充分理由的
opus_summary: Rockstar高级设计总监Scott Butchard表示，《GTA 6》开发初期曾考虑加入任务重玩功能，但该功能与团队想讲述的故事相悖，也会削弱玩家所做选择的意义。游戏目前不支持重玩任务，Rockstar尚未确认未来是否会通过更新加入这一功能。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 gives players a lot of freedom in how the story and quests play out, but it came at the cost of letting players replay missions, according to Rockstar.
paragraphs.cn: 据Rockstar称，《GTA 6》在故事和任务的展开方式上给予了玩家很大的自由，但代价是玩家无法重玩任务。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with Kotaku , Rockstar Games senior design director Scott Butchard explained why the studio scrapped a mission replay menu in GTA 6. Both GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 allowed players to freely replay missions, but that's not the case in GTA 6 . According to Butchard, they considered bringing the feature back, but cut it because it was "at odds" with the story.
paragraphs.cn: 在接受Kotaku采访时，Rockstar高级设计总监Scott Butchard解释了工作室为何取消《GTA 6》中的任务重玩菜单。《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》都允许玩家自由重玩任务，但《GTA 6》并非如此。据Butchard称，他们曾考虑让这一功能回归，但由于它与故事「相冲突」，最终将其砍掉。

paragraphs.en: “Mission replay was certainly something we looked at early on in development, and we do not currently support it,” said Butchard. “As the game came together it felt at odds with the story we were trying to tell and felt a bit alien and disconnected. Sitting outside of the game as it were and replaying missions really diminished the choices you had made.”
paragraphs.cn: Butchard说：「任务重玩确实是我们在开发初期考虑过的功能，而我们目前并不支持它。随着游戏逐渐成形，我们感觉它与我们试图讲述的故事相冲突，感觉有些格格不入、脱节。可以说，置身于游戏之外重玩任务，确实削弱了你所做出的选择的意义。」

paragraphs.en: The lack of a mission replay option has been a point of contention for fans. GTA 6 has some of the best missions in the franchise, particularly the final mission of Chapter 1. Given that GTA 6 can take players anywhere from 50 - 100 hours to finish, most people probably won't start the entire game over just to re-experience their favorite mission. However, it's worth noting that Butchard says the game doesn't "currently support" this feature. Maybe it'll come in the form of an update later, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed that.
paragraphs.cn: 缺少任务重玩选项一直是粉丝争论的焦点。《GTA 6》拥有该系列中一些最出色的任务，尤其是第一章的最终任务。考虑到玩家通关《GTA 6》可能需要50至100小时，大多数人或许不会仅仅为了重新体验自己最喜欢的任务，就把整款游戏从头再玩一遍。不过值得注意的是，Butchard说的是游戏「目前并不支持」这一功能。它也许会在日后通过更新加入，但Rockstar尚未确认这一点。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's story and missions can deviate somewhat significantly based on your choices. Certain characters can be killed or spared, objectives can be completed in different ways, and the entire relationship between Jason and Lucia can vary based on your actions. You can get entirely different dialogue options and cutscenes based on these differences, which might be why a mission replay system isn't as straightforward as it was previous games.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》的故事和任务可能会因你的选择而出现相当大的变化。某些角色可以被杀死或饶过，目标可以通过不同方式完成，Jason和Lucia之间的整个关系也会随着你的行动而变化。根据这些差异，你可能会看到截然不同的对话选项和过场动画，这或许就是任务重玩系统不如前作那么容易实现的原因。

paragraphs.en: However, Red Dead Redemption 2 also featured different choices that changed Arthur's character. It wasn't quite as nuanced as GTA 6's variations, though. Maybe Rockstar will figure out a way to do this, but it clearly fell low on the priority list, if it was on the list at all by the end of development. Even if Rockstar never adds it, modders will probably find a way to slot it in when the inevitable PC version releases.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《荒野大镖客：救赎2》也有会改变Arthur性格的不同选择，只是不像《GTA 6》的变化那样细致。Rockstar也许会找到实现这一功能的方法，但显然它的优先级很低，前提是在开发结束时它还在优先事项列表上的话。即便Rockstar永远不加入这一功能，等到必然会推出的PC版发售时，模组制作者或许也会找到办法将它加进去。

paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？不妨看看IGN上的《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过《新手指南——67条提示与技巧》了解《GTA》的新系统，或者通过《第一章指南与技巧》、《第二章指南与技巧》和《第三章指南与技巧》获取前几章的全部详细信息。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可发现和可做的事情，请查看Leonida互动地图。
